scope: Bounded scene inventory for Android issue #45: all 200 currently tagged onomatopoeia word cards, based on reading their complete current article bodies. Cover the distinct learner uses actually taught, not all retained JMdict senses, every example, synonym comparison, separate homophone or incidental object noun. coverageNotes identify grouped uses and deliberately unexpanded dictionary side notes. Preserve all 120 existing primary assets byte-for-byte, their exact legacy image_scene descriptions and established quiz eligibility; add 80 missing primary targets and bounded secondary targets owned only by their own word. Existing lexical exclusions and owner acceptance remain unchanged. New image eligibility is provisional intent unless accompanied by a hash-pinned advisoryReview of the actual output. Those observations are not owner approval or measured learning effectiveness. quizEligible=false explicitly means article-only, not a uniquely correct picture-quiz answer. Sound, sensation, mental state, time and figurative scenes are intended associations, not sensory proof. New scenarios use tools/image_prompts.json's shared original, text-free square editorial style; prompts omit that shared style. Use unlabelled generic objects, no letters, labels, kana, kanji, numbers, watermarks, named-artist imitation, copied media or graphic distress. This is the authoring inventory with advisory output observations, not a runtime scenes catalog or owner approval record.

あっさり.coverageNotes: Light flavor and readily acting without fuss; agreeing, refusing outright and winning easily share the action sense, not separate food scenes. The new action association is article-only.

scenes.description: A plain ceramic bowl of light clear soup with a few delicate vegetables, transparent broth and very little oil. A simple fresh meal with an uncluttered pale background.
scenes.prompt: A plain ceramic bowl of light clear soup with a few delicate vegetables, transparent broth and very little oil. A simple fresh meal with an uncluttered pale background.
scenes.basis: Meaning and the light-soup example; the article explicitly says light does not mean tasteless.

scenes.sense: Acting readily without resistance or fuss
scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: accepting towels can look like an ordinary handover or helping, without a distinct cue for ready agreement; the excluded きっぱり is not the objection.
scenes.description: A smiling person at a doorway extends both hands toward a stack of folded towels offered by a visitor.
scenes.prompt: An adult at a doorway calmly accepting a small stack of plain folded towels from a neighbor, immediately extending both hands with an easy, unhesitating expression. The neighbor looks relieved; no written request or symbols.
scenes.basis: The request example says they readily agreed to take it on; the distinctive section groups easy winning and outright refusal as action uses.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. The friendly towel handover is coherent and text-free, but the single exchange does not distinguish ready agreement from ordinary helping or receiving. Retain as a caption-supported article association.

あつあつ.coverageNotes: Piping-hot food and the figurative affectionate-couple use both have scenes. The food association is provisionally eligible after symmetric-exclusion review; the couple scene remains article-only. The separate 厚々 word is excluded.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: abundant steam plus cautiously blowing on soup cues piping-hot food. ほかほか is excluded symmetrically and 熱い directly; this need not establish a temperature.

scenes.prompt: An adult holding a spoonful of freshly served soup well away from the lips and cautiously blowing on it; abundant steam rises from the bowl. Show caution around hot food, not a burned tongue or injury.
scenes.basis: Meaning and the soup and freshly served takoyaki examples teach food hot enough to burn.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Blowing lips, a spoon held away from the mouth and substantial steam give a clear piping-hot-food association without injury. The overlapping warm-food word is excluded; no lettering or confusing action was observed.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the close hand-holding couple also fits unexcluded べたべた; mutual affection versus unwelcome clinging needs a clear output distinction.
scenes.description: Two adults sit close together on a park bench, smiling at each other with their hands resting together.
scenes.prompt: Two adult partners sitting close together on a park bench, warmly gazing at each other while holding hands and leaning shoulder to shoulder. Keep the affectionate gesture natural, without heart symbols or writing.
scenes.basis: Meaning, the couple still in love after ten years, and あつあつの二人 explicitly teach the informal couple sense.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. The natural, fully clothed affectionate pose supports the figurative article use. It does not reliably distinguish this couple expression from allowed べたべた or an ordinary close couple, so quiz eligibility remains off.

いらいら.coverageNotes: Irritation and impatient waiting are one related state. The bus-waiting association is provisionally eligible with the actual symmetric exclusions; inspect active impatience rather than weary resignation.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: the empty bus route, tapping foot and tense hands cue impatient waiting. Symmetric exclusions remove むかむか, かりかり, じりじり and ぴりぴり; retain active impatience rather than うんざり's weary resignation.
scenes.description: A person waits beside a bus shelter with hands on hips, looking down an empty road while one foot taps.
scenes.prompt: An adult waiting alone beside a plain bus shelter, brow furrowed and lips pressed tight, tapping one foot and looking down an empty road. Hands rest tensely on the hips; omit timetables, displays, clocks and signs.
scenes.basis: The delayed-bus example and いらいらと待つ teach impatient waiting; the article distinguishes annoyance from mere nervous anticipation.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Hands on hips, a tense sideways look and visible foot-tapping marks convey active impatient waiting rather than the slumped resignation of うんざり. The shelter and empty road are readable; nearby irritation words are excluded.

scenes.prompt: An adult absent-mindedly leaving through the front door while their wallet remains clearly visible on a small table behind them. The departing person is looking elsewhere and has not noticed the forgotten wallet.

うとうと.coverageNotes: One light-dozing sense, not all sleepiness or naps. The new image provisionally targets visibly nodding off rather than claiming measurable sleep depth.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association retained: upright head-nodding and a slipping book distinguish dozing from allowed ぐっすり's settled bed scene. 寝る, 眠る and 睡眠 are excluded; no sleep-depth measurement is required.
scenes.description: A seated person has closed eyes and a drooping head, holding a tilted blank book in their lap beside head-nodding motion marks.
scenes.prompt: An adult sitting upright on a sofa after a meal, eyelids closing as the head droops slightly forward and a loosely held blank book tilts in the lap. Small downward motion arcs suggest a nod; keep the person safely seated, not lying in bed.
scenes.basis: Meaning distinguishes light dozing from deep sleep; the after-lunch sofa example describes actual dozing.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Upright seated posture, closed eyes, a dropping head with motion marks and the loose book clearly associate with nodding off, unlike the settled-bed association of allowed ぐっすり. This is not a measurement of sleep depth; the book is text-free.

うろうろ.coverageNotes: Directionless wandering and restless pacing share the movement sense. The repeated-position composition is provisionally eligible as a backtracking association, subject to clear same-person movement across panels.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: consistent panels showing walking back and forth cue directionless wandering. ふらふら and ぶらぶら are excluded; verify actual backtracking, not merely きょろきょろ's shifting gaze.
scenes.description: Three panels show the same person and shoulder bag in a hall: walking left, pausing uncertainly beside a pillar, then walking right.
scenes.prompt: Three small unlabelled panels show the same adult with the same bag in a simple station hall, first walking left, then pausing uncertainly beside a pillar, then heading back right. Use plain architecture without signs, arrows, maps or lettering.
scenes.basis: The station-exit and waiting-outside-a-shop examples teach uncertainty or restless pacing, not suspicious intent.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Clothing, bag and hall remain consistent across the panels; the legs and body face opposite walking directions around a hesitant pause. The output shows actual backtracking, not only the gaze shifts of きょろきょろ. No labels or arrows were generated.

おどおど.coverageNotes: One timid, hesitant manner, distinct from merely feeling nervous. The interview is a provisional behavioral association after symmetric-exclusion review, not a claim to prove an inner feeling.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: lowered gaze, drawn-in shoulders and a hesitant interview response cue timid behavior. 緊張, はらはら and びくびく are excluded symmetrically; the interaction must read as hesitation rather than general workplace tension.

scenes.prompt: An adult interviewee sitting opposite a calmly attentive adult at a plain table, shoulders drawn inward, hands clasped nervously, eyes lowered and mouth slightly open as if giving a hesitant answer. No paperwork, screens or speech bubbles.
scenes.basis: The first-interview example and おどおどした態度 teach outwardly hesitant behavior.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. The lowered gaze, withdrawn shoulders, clasped hands and hesitant mouth position in a face-to-face exchange support timid behavior, not just an unspecified tense workplace. The listener is calm, and the relevant nervous-state competitors are excluded.

かあかあ.coverageNotes: Repeated crow caws are covered by the accepted image. The child-directed noun for the crow is a side note, not another scene.

scenes.description: A black crow perched on a roof edge cawing with its sturdy beak open and neck slightly extended. Folded wings and a plain sky, with small sound arcs but no letters.
scenes.prompt: A black crow perched on a roof edge cawing with its sturdy beak open and neck slightly extended. Folded wings and a plain sky, with small sound arcs but no letters.

かさかさ.coverageNotes: Dry rough skin and dry rustling are distinct taught uses. The skin association is provisionally eligible with the overlapping texture words excluded, without a diagnosis; the rustling secondary remains article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Inspected association: matte, flaky texture on resting hands beside moisturizer cues dry roughness. Symmetric exclusions remove からから, ざらざら and ぱさぱさ; this is a texture association, not a skin diagnosis.
scenes.description: Two adult hands rest palms-down on a tabletop beside a plain jar of hand moisturizer, with a matte, papery dry texture visible on their backs.
scenes.prompt: A neutral everyday hand-care illustration, cropped to show only two adult hands from the wrists downward resting palms-down on a tabletop. Their backs have a matte, papery dry texture with a few tiny superficial flakes. A plain open jar of hand moisturizer sits beside them. A static texture study with no rubbing action, no lettering or branding.
scenes.revisionNote: The original hand-cream application request was rejected at the provider's input moderation stage. Its receipt is retained without an image. This separate, neutral resting-hands composition retains the taught dry-skin sense; no moderation setting was changed.
scenes.basis: The winter-hands example and かさかさの肌 teach moisture-deprived rough skin without diagnosing a condition.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Two coherently drawn resting hands show visible fine matte flakes and dry texture beside an unlabelled moisturizer jar, without wounds or an invented diagnosis. The relevant dryness and roughness competitors are excluded. This is the distinct revised composition, not an output of the rejected request.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: loose leaves may read as fluttering for allowed ひらひら rather than dry contact/rustling; excluded ざわざわ is not a competing answer.
scenes.description: Curled brown leaves lift above a stone path, with thin white motion arcs suggesting a light breeze.
scenes.prompt: A few curled dry brown leaves skittering over a stone path in a mild breeze, their thin edges brushing each other. Use subtle motion arcs and a quiet, sparse background rather than a storm.
scenes.basis: Meaning names paper or dead leaves; the wind-blown dead-leaves example explicitly teaches rustling.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected at stored size. Crisp curled leaves, a quiet path and light movement are a coherent dry-rustling association. Several leaves are airborne without clear contact, however, so allowed ひらひら remains a defensible reading. Keep this scene article-only.

かたかた.coverageNotes: Light repeated hard rattling is covered by the accepted shutter. Keyboard typing is another example of this sound quality, not a separate sense; grumbling is explicitly not taught.

scenes.description: A lightweight wooden storm shutter making a light rattle in a breeze, narrow slats tapping gently against the frame. Close-up of the small repeated movement, no damage or writing.
scenes.prompt: A lightweight wooden storm shutter making a light rattle in a breeze, narrow slats tapping gently against the frame. Close-up of the small repeated movement, no damage or writing.
scenes.basis: Meaning and the storm-shutter example teach small hard repeated sounds.

かちかち.coverageNotes: Hard objects, repeated clicks, nervous stiffness and a rigid outlook are explicitly taught. The accepted hard-bread image stays eligible; new clicking, nervous and outlook scenes are article-only, with no implied hardness scale.

scenes.description: A hand pressing a loaf of bread taken from a freezer, the bread remaining rigid and rock-hard with a few ice crystals on its surface. A plain open freezer in the background, no display or labels.
scenes.prompt: A hand pressing a loaf of bread taken from a freezer, the bread remaining rigid and rock-hard with a few ice crystals on its surface. A plain open freezer in the background, no display or labels.
scenes.basis: The freezer-bread example and かちかちに凍る teach physical hardness.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the tiny escapement must read as repeated hard contact, rather than a generic clock or rotating mechanism; the already-excluded rattling words need not be distinguished.
scenes.description: A mechanical clock has a blank face and exposed toothed gears, with small motion marks beside a contacting part.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a simple mechanical clock with a completely blank face and two plain hands, its exposed side showing a small toothed escapement engaging. Fine repeated motion marks near the mechanism suggest ticking; no numerals or dial markings.
scenes.basis: Meaning and 時計がかちかちと音を立てている teach clock-like clicking.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected on the contact sheet and enlarged at stored size. The exposed teeth, contacting part and local ticking marks resolve the generic-clock hold. This is a familiar small-hard-click association; the other pictured rattling/clicking neighbors are excluded, and no separate ticking-word card is present. Promoted to eligible without claiming audible proof or engineering precision.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the nervous presenter also fits allowed おどおど or a tense ぴりぴり atmosphere. Bodily rigidity needs more than an undifferentiated anxious expression.
scenes.description: A nervous-looking presenter stands rigidly behind a lectern, shoulders raised and fists held at their sides, facing a seated audience.
scenes.prompt: An adult about to address a small seated audience, standing unusually rigid with raised shoulders, straight arms and tightly held hands beside the body. A bare lectern and blank backdrop keep attention on the tense posture.
scenes.basis: Distinctive meaning explicitly says the word can describe someone tense with nerves.

advisoryReview.note: The rigid shoulders and straight arms are visible, but the anxious presenter also fits allowed おどおど. Retain the bodily-stiffness association in the article rather than treating the nervous pose as a unique answer. No lettering was observed.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: refusing an alternative can cue allowed きっぱり's decisiveness just as readily as an inflexible outlook; the proposed disagreement does not resolve that distinction.
scenes.description: At a table with two arrangements of wooden blocks, one person turns away with folded arms while another offers an alternative.
scenes.prompt: At a craft table, one adult holds firmly to a neat arrangement of plain wooden blocks while another gently offers a different arrangement beside it. The first adult folds their arms and turns away from the alternative. No instructional diagrams or words.
scenes.basis: Distinctive meaning explicitly names a rigid outlook; this illustrative disagreement cannot prove inflexibility and needs article context.

advisoryReview.note: The two block arrangements and turned-away folded-arm refusal are coherent. Refusing a proposal remains compatible with allowed きっぱり and does not distinguish an enduring rigid outlook. Retain as a contextual article scene.

からから.coverageNotes: Parched dryness, empty containers, dry rattling and loud open laughter are explicitly taught. The parched runner is provisionally eligible as a learned cue; the three secondary flags remain article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: touching the throat and reaching for water after running cues being parched. かさかさ and ぱさぱさ are excluded; distinguish thirst before drinking from the allowed gulping pictures.
scenes.description: A person in exercise clothes rests in the shade, touching their throat while reaching for a glass of water.
scenes.prompt: An adult runner paused safely in shade after exercise, touching the front of the throat with a dry-mouthed uncomfortable expression while reaching toward a plain glass of water. No medical symptoms or graphic dehydration.
scenes.basis: The running example teaches a parched throat and the distinctive section gives からからに乾く.

advisoryReview.note: The throat touch, uncomfortable open mouth, exercise clothing and reach toward water support being parched before drinking. The person is not gulping, which distinguishes the allowed drinking-action scenes; nearby dryness words are excluded. No injury or text was observed.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: an empty dry jar may cue either emptiness or the word's dryness; inspect whether the open interior makes the intended empty-container association explicit.
scenes.description: A plain ceramic storage jar lies tipped toward the viewer, showing its empty interior beside its detached lid.
scenes.prompt: A clean plain ceramic storage jar tipped toward the viewer so its entire empty interior is visible, with its detached lid beside it. No dust, contents, lettering or decorative motifs.
scenes.basis: Meaning says empty or hollow; からからの容器 is explicitly explained as an empty container.

advisoryReview.note: The large unobstructed opening clearly reveals a completely empty container. The held distinction between emptiness and dryness is between senses of this same word, not opposing word answers. No competing empty-container onomatopoeia card was found in the current corpus. Promoted as the explicitly taught empty-container association.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: a rolling can can also cue allowed ころころ or ごろごろ. The hollow rattle needs an identifiable emphasis beyond travel across the ground.
scenes.description: An unlabelled empty metal can rolls on its side along a stone path, its open end visible beside curved motion marks.
scenes.prompt: A single clean empty metal can rolling on its side over a paved path in a light breeze. Its open hollow end is visible, with short broken motion arcs at the points where metal taps the ground; no label.
scenes.basis: The wind-blown empty-can example teaches a rattling sound while rolling.

advisoryReview.note: The hollow can is clear, but the broad motion arcs emphasize rolling rather than repeated hollow contact. Allowed ころころ and ごろごろ remain defensible. Keep the rattling interpretation caption-supported and article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: げらげら is excluded, but bright open laughter remains compatible with allowed ころころ. The broad laughing pose needs an adjudicated cue distinction.
scenes.description: An older adult laughs openly at an outdoor table while a companion smiles beside them.
scenes.prompt: An older adult seated comfortably outdoors, laughing openly with head slightly back, mouth wide and shoulders relaxed; a nearby adult smiles in response. No speech bubbles or cues of mockery.
scenes.basis: The grandfather laughing at a joke and the distinctive explanation teach audible open laughter, not dehydration.

advisoryReview.note: The open mouth, tipped-back head and relaxed shared laugh are coherent. They do not distinguish this audible laugh quality from allowed ころころ, so the scene remains article-only. The output depicts an older woman rather than tying the illustration to the example's grandfather.

かりかり.coverageNotes: Hard dry crispness, a scratching sound and irritability are taught separately. Dry-kibble naming is a side noun note and does not get another image. Crisp bacon is provisionally eligible after exclusion review; the two secondaries remain article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: stiff browned bacon is a taught hard-crisp prototype. Symmetric exclusions remove こりこり, さくさく, しゃきしゃき, ぱりぱり, ばりばり and ぽりぽり; no bite-sound proof is needed.
scenes.description: A fork lifts a stiff, browned strip of bacon above a plate of crisp, rippled strips.
scenes.prompt: A plain plate holding well-cooked crisp bacon strips; a fork lifts one stiff browned strip with a visibly dry, rippled edge. Avoid smoke, dripping fat or soft bending texture.
scenes.basis: The bacon cooked crisp example and かりかりした食感 teach desirable firm crispness.

advisoryReview.note: The lifted strip stays stiff and has strongly browned, dry-looking rippled edges, supporting the taught crisp-bacon prototype. No flowing fat or steam obscures the texture; the other close crispness words are excluded.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the pencil tip and paper grain must cue scratching friction rather than merely writing, which can also suggest allowed さらさら's fluent execution.
scenes.description: A sharpened pencil makes short rough graphite marks on textured white paper, with small motion marks beside its tip.
scenes.prompt: A hand drawing a few short abstract graphite strokes with a sharpened pencil on otherwise blank paper. Emphasize the pencil tip rubbing against visible paper grain with tiny motion marks; the marks must not resemble letters, numbers or a copied drawing.
scenes.basis: The pencil making a scratching sound on paper is an explicit example.

advisoryReview.note: The close-up shows contact, paper grain and abstract scribbles rather than readable writing. It supports the scratching example, but does not sufficiently distinguish the sound/manner from allowed さらさら's writing use. Keep article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: いらいら and むかむか are excluded, but the tense coworker interaction still resembles allowed ぴりぴり's workplace tension.
scenes.description: A frowning person sits with folded arms at a table while another person gently offers a glass of water.
scenes.prompt: An adult seated at a simple worktable with tight shoulders and a pinched frown, bristling slightly as a calm colleague gently offers a cup of water. No pointing accusations, threats, screens or writing.
scenes.basis: The request not to get worked up and the distinctive section explicitly teach an irritable mood.

advisoryReview.note: The tight frown and defensive folded arms visibly support irritability. The tense interaction also fits allowed ぴりぴり, even though other anger neighbors are excluded. Retain a neutral observed caption rather than asserting a specific colleague relationship.

scenes.description: An old window rattling in gusty wind, its loose frame visibly vibrating with several short motion marks along the edges. A slightly uneven pane and simple interior, no broken glass.
scenes.prompt: An old window rattling in gusty wind, its loose frame visibly vibrating with several short motion marks along the edges. A slightly uneven pane and simple interior, no broken glass.
scenes.basis: The windy-window example teaches repeated rattling.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary status retained pending output review: ぐらぐら is excluded; the key unresolved cue is whether loose joints and actual wobble are visible rather than simply old furniture.

advisoryReview.note: Inspected on the sheet and enlarged at stored size. Promoted as the taught rickety-desk association.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the dissatisfied gesturing speaker can also fit allowed ずけずけ's blunt manner; the usual grumbling neighbors are already excluded and are not the objection.

scenes.basis: がたがた言う and the brusque stop-griping phrase explicitly teach complaints rather than a literal rattle.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the usual delay words are excluded, but fussing with a bag may read as allowed うっかり's oversight or ordinary preparation rather than reluctance to start.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the panels may cue individual allowed rain words such as しとしと rather than a changing unsettled spell; the cross-panel weather pattern needs adjudication.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the loosely fitting handle is also a direct cue for unexcluded ぐらぐら. The article's brief looseness use does not provide a stronger picture distinction.

ぐっしょり.coverageNotes: One thoroughly soaked state across sweat, rain, hair and fabric. Use a sweat-soaked shirt; separate liquids are not separate senses. The primary is provisionally eligible because the overlapping soaked-state words are symmetrically excluded.

scenes.description: A person rests after exercise with damp hair, a towel and an opaque shirt darkened by a large sweat-soaked area.

advisoryReview.note: The broad saturated fabric patch is the central cue, not flowing sweat trails. The shirt stays opaque and the person is not in distress; the close wetness words are excluded.

ぐっすり.coverageNotes: Deep sound sleep is one taught sense. Preserve the accepted sleeping image without adding an unobservable depth measurement or a separate infant scene.

advisoryReview.note: Enlarged at stored size. The comfortable, alert expression and reclined pose also clearly fit unexcluded ごろごろ's lounging use. The planned quiz eligibility is withdrawn: this remains an article illustration, not a reliably distinctive listlessness question. No lexical exclusion was invented to hide the overlap.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: ぐつぐつ is excluded, but allowed ぶくぶく and ぷくぷく also fit prominent bubbles. The boiling-water context needs inspection against those picture choices.

scenes.prompt: A cat chasing its own tail, spinning round and round in a circle, with curved motion trails.

scenes.prompt: Three unlabelled panels show the same adult at the same table, repeatedly returning a worried gaze to one uncompleted plain wooden puzzle while pausing with a hand to the temple. No brain diagram, thought bubbles or writing.
scenes.basis: 頭の中で同じ考えがぐるぐる回る explicitly teaches a recurring thought; the panels need article context.

げほげほ.coverageNotes: One forceful repeated cough sense; causes and possible sound qualities do not diagnose illness or create separate pictures. Preserve the accepted dusty-shelf cough.

scenes.prompt: An adult turning away from a lightly dusty shelf and coughing heavily into their bent elbow, eyes squeezed shut. A small dust cloud explains the cough; no germs, illness labels or graphic detail.

げらげら.coverageNotes: One loud unrestrained laughter sense, without assigning kindness or cruelty. The open hearty laugh is provisionally eligible as a conventional cue, with restrained giggling still requiring visible separation.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: open mouths, tipped-back heads and free shoulder movement cue hearty laughter, unlike allowed くすくす's restrained hand-covered giggles. からから, 笑い and 笑う are excluded.
scenes.description: Two adults laugh with mouths wide open and heads tipped back, one resting a hand on their stomach.
scenes.prompt: Two adults seated comfortably, laughing heartily with mouths open, heads tipped slightly back and shoulders moving freely. One rests a hand on their own stomach; no joke text, exaggerated tears or speech bubbles.

advisoryReview.note: The open, unrestrained laughing poses clearly differ from hand-covered giggling or a closed-mouth grin. The close loud-laughter neighbor is excluded, and no sound lettering is present.

こけこっこー.coverageNotes: The rooster's crow is the taught sound. Preserve its accepted image; the child-directed rooster noun is only a side note and does not get a second scene.

scenes.prompt: A rooster perched on a plain wooden fence at sunrise, neck stretched upward and beak open in a crow. Bright red comb, folded wings and small sound arcs without lettering.

こそこそ.coverageNotes: Secret speech and stealthy movement share avoiding-notice behavior. The furtive exit is provisionally eligible with the secrecy/whisper neighbors excluded; no wrongdoing is asserted.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: checking behind oneself while slipping through a side door cues furtive avoidance of notice. こっそり, そっと and ひそひそ are symmetrically excluded; no wrongdoing need be implied.
scenes.description: A person carrying a wrapped gift slips through a doorway while turning their head to check behind them.
scenes.prompt: An adult quietly slipping through a plain side doorway, body angled discreetly and head turned to check whether anyone has noticed. A harmless wrapped gift is tucked under one arm; no locks being forced, criminal cues or writing.
scenes.basis: Meaning and the back-entrance example teach secret action, not necessarily wrongdoing.

advisoryReview.note: The angled quiet step, backward check and tucked-away gift provide a clear furtive-action association without implying wrongdoing. The closest discreet-action words are excluded.

こっそり.coverageNotes: One discreetly avoiding-notice sense. Preserve the accepted surprise-gift image; quietly leaving is another application, not another sense.

scenes.description: An adult quietly preparing a wrapped present behind a partly open door while the intended recipient faces away in the other room. A secret friendly surprise, plain wrapping with no card or writing.
scenes.prompt: An adult quietly preparing a wrapped present behind a partly open door while the intended recipient faces away in the other room. A secret friendly surprise, plain wrapping with no card or writing.
scenes.basis: The secretly prepared present explicitly illustrates concealment without wrongdoing.

こってり.coverageNotes: Rich food, substantial coating and severe scolding are explicitly taught. Preserve rich broth; coating and scolding are article-only additions.

scenes.description: A close-up of a plain bowl of ramen with visibly rich thick creamy broth, glossy droplets of oil and substantial noodles. Emphasize the dense hearty soup rather than steam.
scenes.prompt: A close-up of a plain bowl of ramen with visibly rich thick creamy broth, glossy droplets of oil and substantial noodles. Emphasize the dense hearty soup rather than steam.
scenes.basis: The ramen-broth example teaches a rich heavy quality rather than merely thick flow.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: a thick butter layer also fits allowed べたべた's extensive application; the proposed coating does not yet give a fair contrast.

scenes.basis: The thick butter-on-toast example explicitly teaches substantial application.

advisoryReview.note: The generous coating is clear, but allowed べたべた can also describe extensive application. Keep the substantial-coating use in the article rather than treating thickness as unique.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the stern speaker can also cue allowed ずけずけ or きっぱり; the listener's lowered gaze does not separate severity from bluntness or firmness.

ことこと.coverageNotes: Quiet simmering and gentle repeated clinks or rattles are taught. Gentle bean simmering is provisionally eligible after exclusion review; the lid-rattle secondary remains article-only. No fixed bubble-size or sound-volume boundary is asserted.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: beans gently simmering in a stable pot are the direct taught cue. Symmetric exclusions remove ぐつぐつ, ぶくぶく, ぷくぷく and the light-rattle neighbors; no temperature threshold is needed.
scenes.description: Beans simmer in a steady pot with small bubbles near the edge and light steam.

advisoryReview.note: The settled bean surface and small edge bubbles give a gentle-simmer association rather than a heaving rolling boil. The relevant bubbling and light-rattle neighbors are excluded.

scenes.sense: A gentle repeated clink or rattle
scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary status retained pending output review: the rattling neighbors are excluded; inspect whether lid-to-rim contact reads clearly rather than merely steam from a cooking pot.

advisoryReview.note: Lid-to-rim contact and localized motion marks are the focus, not generic cooking steam. The light-rattle hold is resolved and the neighboring rattling words are excluded; promoted.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: recognizable firm wood-ear mushrooms supply the article's bite-texture prototype. かりかり, さくさく, しゃきしゃき, ぱりぱり and hardness words are excluded; retain firm ruffles rather than generic chewing.

scenes.prompt: An adult taking a small bite of a cooked wood-ear mushroom held in chopsticks, with a plain dish of dark ruffled mushrooms nearby. The mushroom looks firm and flexible rather than dry and crumbly; no labels.

advisoryReview.note: The recognizable flexible ruffled mushrooms match the taught firm-bite prototype rather than dry crumbs or brittle chips. The close crispness and hardness competitors are excluded.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: shoulder rubbing can also cue allowed ずきずき or じんじん discomfort; tight muscle resistance is not yet a distinct visual focus.

こんこん.coverageNotes: Knocking, repeated coughs, a fox's cry and steadily falling snow are explicitly taught. Separate homophones 懇々, 昏々 and 滾々 are excluded. The knocking primary and fox-call secondary are provisional quiz intentions; cough and snow remain article-only.

advisoryReview.note: The explicit speaking-pause-speaking sequence foregrounds interrupted delivery rather than a uniformly reflective mood. Promote without claiming a particular volume or topic.

ぽりぽり.coverageNotes: Light crunchy bites and small scratching movements are distinct taught actions. Preserve accepted cucumber; head scratching is article-only without diagnosing an itch or assuming embarrassment.

scenes.description: An adult taking a small crisp bite from a fresh cucumber stick, a neat bite mark and a few tiny crumbs of cucumber visible. Focus on the light crunchy eating action.
scenes.prompt: An adult taking a small crisp bite from a fresh cucumber stick, a neat bite mark and a few tiny crumbs of cucumber visible. Focus on the light crunchy eating action.
scenes.basis: The cucumber example explicitly teaches eating with light crunches.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: scratching the head can also cue allowed むずむず's itch or ちくちく's irritation. Small repeated scratching, not discomfort alone, must be the focus.
scenes.description: A person makes small repeated fingertip scratches at the side of their head with a neutral thoughtful expression.
scenes.prompt: An adult gently scratching the side of the head with a few fingertips, short repeated motion arcs and a neutral thoughtful face. No rash, injury, embarrassment symbols or lettering.
scenes.basis: The head-scratching example explicitly teaches the action without establishing its emotion or medical cause.

advisoryReview.note: Visible fingertip movement and short arcs make the scratching action central, without depicting irritation or a cause. Promote.

むかむか.coverageNotes: Nausea and rising anger/disgust are distinct taught feelings. Meal-related queasiness is provisionally eligible with food-aversion cues distinct from gripping pain; anger remains article-only. Both depictions stay non-graphic and non-diagnostic.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: pushing a rich meal aside with a mildly queasy face and upper-abdomen hand cues nausea. Anger neighbors are excluded; inspect food aversion rather than allowed きりきり's gripping-pain posture.
scenes.description: A person presses their lips uneasily and rests a hand on the upper abdomen beside a partly finished meal and water.
scenes.prompt: An adult pausing after a rich meal, one hand resting lightly on the upper abdomen and lips pressed with mild queasiness. A plain plate pushed aside and a glass of water nearby; no vomiting, injury or diagnosis.
scenes.basis: The greasy-food example teaches nausea without saying the person vomited.

advisoryReview.note: The queasy after-meal expression and loose hand differ from gripping or doubled-over pain. No vomiting or diagnosis is inferred.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: いらいら and かりかり are excluded, but the tense seated adult can still resemble allowed ぴりぴり; rising disgust needs a clearer cue than tension alone.
scenes.description: A person sits with brows drawn together and tense closed hands resting on a table.
scenes.prompt: An adult seated alone after an unpleasant conversation, jaw set and eyebrows drawn together, hands tense but resting safely on the table. No threats, insult text, violent gesture or stomach-illness cues.
scenes.basis: Remembering a rude way of speaking explicitly teaches anger rising without literal nausea.

advisoryReview.note: Anger is plausible, but remains difficult to distinguish from a tense irritable state. Retain article-only.

むしゃむしゃ.coverageNotes: One repeated vigorous chewing sense across grass or rice. Preserve accepted munching horse; the explicitly archaic shaggy sense is excluded.

scenes.description: A healthy horse eagerly munching a mouthful of green grass in a meadow, several grass blades sticking out from the chewing mouth. Close-up of the head and grass.
scenes.prompt: A healthy horse eagerly munching a mouthful of green grass in a meadow, several grass blades sticking out from the chewing mouth. Close-up of the head and grass.
scenes.basis: The horse-grass and hungry rice-ball examples teach vigorous chewing without requiring crunchiness.

むずむず.coverageNotes: Physical itchy/tickly sensation and eager urge to act are explicitly distinct. Preserve accepted nose; restless eagerness is article-only and does not require skin itch.

scenes.description: An adult with a ticklish nose just before a sneeze, one fingertip rubbing the side of the nose, eyes half closed. A clean close-up with a soft plain background.
scenes.prompt: An adult with a ticklish nose just before a sneeze, one fingertip rubbing the side of the nose, eyes half closed. A clean close-up with a soft plain background.
scenes.basis: The nose-before-a-sneeze example teaches physical tickling.

scenes.sense: An eager restless urge to act
scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: eagerness at new shoes also cues allowed わくわく or うきうき. The restless urge to act is not yet distinct from cheerful anticipation.
scenes.description: An eager runner leans through an open doorway toward the path with arms bent and one heel raised.
scenes.prompt: An adult in new plain running shoes at an open doorway, body leaning eagerly toward the outdoor path, hands ready and face impatiently excited. No scratching, branded shoes, race numbers or text.
scenes.basis: The new-shoes example and 何かしたくてむずむずする explicitly teach an urge to do something.

advisoryReview.note: The energetic launch also fits happy anticipation or simply beginning to run; a restless urge before acting is not distinct. Retain article-only.

めそめそ.coverageNotes: One tearful whimpering sense whose critical observer stance need not be encoded in the picture. The broken-toy whimper is provisionally eligible with the closest crying words excluded, without imposing belittlement or depicting serious grief.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: moist eyes, a trembling lip and a broken toy cue tearful whimpering. しくしく, わんわん, くんくん and 泣く are excluded; the image need not encode or endorse the speaker's belittling stance.
scenes.description: A tearful child sits beside a toy truck with a detached wheel while a caring adult offers a tissue.
scenes.prompt: A child sitting beside a harmless toy with a detached wheel, eyes moist and lips trembling slightly while a caring adult offers a plain tissue. Mild everyday upset, no scolding, humiliation or severe distress.
scenes.basis: The broken-toy example teaches whimpering; the article warns that speaker stance matters, not crying volume alone.

advisoryReview.note: Moist eyes and a small trembling pout provide mild whimpering rather than loud wailing; the close crying words are excluded.

めらめら.coverageNotes: Visible flaring fire and a figurative flare of emotion are taught. Preserve accepted flames; one article-only determination association represents the metaphor, with jealousy another possible subject rather than a separate picture.

scenes.description: Tall bright flames flaring upward inside a safe stone fireplace, long tongues of orange and yellow fire rising from the logs. Focus on visible flame movement, with very little smoke and no flying sparks.
scenes.prompt: Tall bright flames flaring upward inside a safe stone fireplace, long tongues of orange and yellow fire rising from the logs. Focus on visible flame movement, with very little smoke and no flying sparks.
scenes.basis: The fireplace and campfire examples foreground visible flame, not crackling sound.

scenes.sense: An emotion flaring like a flame
scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: a determined athlete with a flame metaphor also cues allowed もりもり or むずむず motivation. The decorative flame does not yet make one emotional association fair.
scenes.description: A determined athlete stands beside a separate stylized flame-shaped glow.
scenes.prompt: An adult athlete standing safely before practice with an intensely determined gaze and hands resting firmly at the sides; a small separate abstract flame-shaped glow behind the figure serves as a visual metaphor, not fire touching the body. No team logo, slogans or threatening pose.
scenes.basis: Distinctive meaning explicitly permits a figurative flame of jealousy or determination; the subject supplies the emotion.

advisoryReview.note: The flame metaphor supports the article, but does not separate flaring determination from other eligible motivation and eagerness words. Retain article-only.

もくもく.coverageNotes: One rising puffs/billows sense across smoke and clouds. Preserve accepted billows; 黙々 silent work is explicitly another lexical identity and excluded.

scenes.sense: Smoke or clouds rising in billows
scenes.description: Thick soft grey smoke billowing upward from a simple brick chimney in rounded expanding clouds. Clear sky and one chimney, with no flames, factory signs or writing.
scenes.prompt: Thick soft grey smoke billowing upward from a simple brick chimney in rounded expanding clouds. Clear sky and one chimney, with no flames, factory signs or writing.
scenes.basis: The chimney-smoke and growing-cloud examples teach billowing, not silent concentration.

もぐもぐ.coverageNotes: Small chewing movements and indistinct mumbling are taught. Preserve accepted chewing; speech is article-only. The dictionary-only wriggling note is explicitly outside the main learning scene.

scenes.sense: Small repeated mouth movements while chewing
scenes.description: A child sitting at a table chewing a bite of plain bread with mouth closed and gently rounded cheeks, holding the remaining bread. Focus on the small repeated chewing movement.
scenes.prompt: A child sitting at a table chewing a bite of plain bread with mouth closed and gently rounded cheeks, holding the remaining bread. Focus on the small repeated chewing movement.
scenes.basis: The child chewing bread teaches mouth movement without necessarily noise or greed.

scenes.sense: Speech remaining indistinct in the mouth
scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: ぼそぼそ is excluded, but barely parted lips can still resemble allowed ひそひそ's undertones. Indistinct articulation versus quiet speech needs inspection.
scenes.description: A person speaks behind a cupped hand while a companion leans toward them.
scenes.prompt: An adult trying to speak with lips barely parted and small inward mouth movements while another adult listens closely. No food in the mouth, speech bubbles, secrecy props or written words.
scenes.basis: The request to say it again without mumbling explicitly teaches もぐもぐ言う apart from eating.

advisoryReview.note: The generated hand-to-mouth pose reads directly as whispering, not distinctly unclear articulation. Retain article-only.

もこもこ.coverageNotes: Bulky rounded fluff and non-fluffy bulges/lumpiness are taught. Preserve accepted fleece; add article-only uneven rounded form. Layered clothing shares bulk, while muscle mention is an application rather than a separate body scene.

scenes.description: A child wearing a thick fluffy fleece jacket with a big hood, the fleece looks dense and woolly, winter morning.
scenes.prompt: A child wearing a thick fluffy fleece jacket with a big hood, the fleece looks dense and woolly, winter morning.
scenes.basis: The jacket and layered-sweater examples teach plush or inconvenient clothing bulk.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: rounded uneven clay also fits allowed でこぼこ. Bulky adjoining bulges rather than generic highs and lows need a distinct output.
scenes.description: A clay mound forms several adjoining rounded bulges beside a resting hand.
scenes.prompt: A mound of firm plain modeling clay shaped into several rounded adjoining bulges, clearly uneven in outline but with smooth non-furry surfaces. A hand rests beside it for scale; no letters, faces or copied sculpture.
scenes.basis: Meaning allows lumpiness rather than softness and distinctive meaning explicitly extends bulging to uneven shapes or muscles.

advisoryReview.note: Lumpiness is clear, but generic uneven highs and lows remain an available answer. Retain article-only.

もちもち.coverageNotes: Springy elastic food texture and supple skin are explicitly taught. Smooth elastic dough is provisionally eligible with ぷにぷに excluded; supple skin remains article-only. Neither means hard-to-chew food or literally chewy skin.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: smooth dough stretching as one resistant elastic piece is a taught food-texture cue. ぷにぷに and 柔らかい are excluded; inspect cohesive elasticity rather than allowed ねばねば's fine sticky threads or ぐにゃぐにゃ's limp bending.
scenes.description: Two hands stretch a small piece of dough into one smooth cohesive elastic band.
scenes.prompt: Two hands gently stretching a small piece of plain dumpling dough, showing smooth elastic resistance and a soft rounded body rather than sticky strings or airy crumbs. Clean tabletop, no recipe text or labels.
scenes.basis: The udon and elastic-dough examples teach soft pleasant resistance.

advisoryReview.note: The resistant unified stretch contrasts with fine sticky threads, fluffy pores and limp bending.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: ぷにぷに is excluded, but gently pressed skin may still cue allowed すべすべ or しっとり. Supple rebound versus smoothness/moisture needs inspection.
scenes.description: A person lightly presses their cheek with one fingertip, creating a small soft indentation.
scenes.prompt: An adult lightly pressing their own cheek with one fingertip, a shallow soft indentation in healthy-looking skin and a relaxed expression. No biting, pinching, cosmetic labels, before-and-after claim or diagnosis.
scenes.basis: Distinctive meaning explicitly mentions supple skin, where chewy would be a misleading translation.

advisoryReview.note: The visible local dent foregrounds supple yielding rather than surface smoothness or moisture, without lotion or wet sheen. The closest squishy word is excluded; promote.

もやもや.coverageNotes: Hazy appearance and unresolved vague unease are two taught uses; the noun for the feeling shares the latter. The hazy-mountain primary is provisionally eligible with ぼんやり and ぼうっと excluded; unresolved unease remains article-only and non-diagnostic.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: a mountain obscured by loose murky mist directly cues haziness. ぼんやり and ぼうっと are symmetrically excluded; allowed もくもく depicts rising chimney billows rather than obscured terrain.
scenes.description: Loose banks of mist obscure portions of a distant mountain above a quiet valley.
scenes.prompt: A distant mountain partly obscured by loose patches of low mist, contours blending into pale gray air above a quiet valley. No person with a distracted face, writing or dramatic storm.
scenes.basis: The mountain hazy through mist explicitly teaches visible murkiness.

advisoryReview.note: Murkiness obscuring terrain is clear, without rising chimney billows or a distracted person.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: a troubled person confiding in a friend can also cue allowed くよくよ or しんみり. The hand-to-chest gesture does not yet distinguish unresolved unease.
scenes.description: A mildly troubled person rests a hand over their chest while speaking with an attentive friend.
scenes.prompt: An adult talking with a sympathetic friend at a plain table, one hand resting over the chest and a mildly troubled uncertain expression while the friend listens. No thought bubbles, diagnosis, written reasons or assumed single emotion.
scenes.basis: The unexplained-reason and talking-to-a-friend examples teach unresolved dissatisfaction or unease, also used as a noun.

advisoryReview.note: Confiding and unease are visible, but unresolved feelings are not distinguished from worry or reflective conversation. Retain article-only.

もりもり.coverageNotes: Hearty appetite, energetic work and motivation/strength welling up are explicitly taught. Preserve accepted breakfast; work and rising motivation are article-only additions, not crunchy-food claims.

scenes.description: A cheerful child heartily eating a substantial breakfast, holding a rice bowl and eagerly taking another bite with chopsticks. Several simple nourishing dishes, energetic appetite, no packages.
scenes.prompt: A cheerful child heartily eating a substantial breakfast, holding a rice bowl and eagerly taking another bite with chopsticks. Several simple nourishing dishes, energetic appetite, no packages.
scenes.basis: The children eating breakfast teach appetite rather than food crunchiness.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: the energetic-work neighbors are excluded, but orderly digging can still cue allowed しっかり. Inspect unmistakable vigor rather than careful execution.
scenes.description: A gardener bends over a bed, digging a neat row of planting holes with a hand trowel.
scenes.prompt: An adult energetically digging a small garden bed with a short hand tool, upright engaged posture and a neat row of completed planting holes nearby. Safe controlled work, no productivity numbers or writing.
scenes.basis: もりもり働く explicitly teaches energetic work.

advisoryReview.note: Orderly careful work is visible, but pronounced vigor is not separated from thorough execution. Retain article-only.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: becoming eager after encouragement also cues allowed わくわく or むずむず; rising motivation versus anticipation or urge remains unresolved.
scenes.description: Two panels show a discouraged tennis player becoming animated and raising a small determined fist after a companion's encouragement.
scenes.prompt: Two unlabelled panels show an adult at a simple practice area: first hesitant with lowered shoulders, then visibly energized and ready to start after a companion's supportive open-handed gesture. No slogans, arrows, scores or magical power effects.
scenes.basis: The encouragement example explicitly teaches motivation welling up.

advisoryReview.note: The direct discouraged-to-energized contrast and supportive interaction make motivation welling up clearer than generic anticipation of an unseen event. Promote.

ゆらゆら.coverageNotes: One repeated swaying/rocking movement across curtain, boat or flame. Preserve accepted curtain; changing objects do not create separate senses or damage claims.

scenes.description: A light curtain hanging beside an open window and swaying gently back and forth, its fabric forming soft alternating curves. Quiet interior, no strong wind or violent flapping.
scenes.prompt: A light curtain hanging beside an open window and swaying gently back and forth, its fabric forming soft alternating curves. Quiet interior, no strong wind or violent flapping.
scenes.basis: The curtain and boat examples, plus wavering flame, share the same motion quality.

よちよち.coverageNotes: One toddling gait, not emotion or a diagnosis. A safely supported toddler association is provisional quiz intent, with no adult ridicule.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association retained: a toddler's small uncertain supported steps toward a caregiver are the direct cue. ちょこちょこ is excluded in reverse; allowed ふらふら's adult standing imbalance has a different gait/context.
scenes.description: A toddler takes short wide-set steps with arms lifted for balance toward a nearby seated caregiver.
scenes.prompt: A toddler taking short uncertain steps across a soft level rug toward a seated caregiver with open supporting arms, feet slightly apart and hands raised for balance. Caregiver close enough to help, no fall, text or walker branding.
scenes.basis: The baby and little-brother examples teach small unsteady walking steps.

advisoryReview.note: The uncertain early-walking gait and available support distinguish toddling from ordinary walking or an adult's dizziness.

わくわく.coverageNotes: One eager anticipation sense, whether a trip, opening a box or an exciting story. Eager opening before the contents are revealed is provisionally eligible because うきうき, ぞくぞく and どきどき are symmetrically excluded.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Provisional association: leaning eagerly into a box before its contents are revealed cues anticipation. うきうき, ぞくぞく and どきどき are excluded; inspect forward-looking curiosity rather than allowed にっこり's smile after receiving a gift.
scenes.description: Two children lean eagerly toward a plain box as they lift its lid before the contents become visible.
scenes.prompt: Two children eagerly lifting the lid of a plain unmarked box, bright attentive eyes and bodies leaning forward before the contents are visible. No branded toy, gift lettering, surprise explosion or speech bubbles.
scenes.basis: The children opening a box explicitly teaches looking forward eagerly to what comes next.

advisoryReview.note: Forward attention toward the unrevealed contents clearly supplies anticipation rather than only a smile at a received gift.

わんわん.coverageNotes: Barking, loud human wailing and loud resounding noise are explicitly taught. Preserve accepted dog; crying and general resonance are article-only additions. The doggy noun is a child-speech side note.

scenes.description: A dog standing alert in front of a garden gate and barking with its mouth open. Friendly natural anatomy and small sound arcs, not snarling or threatening anyone.
scenes.prompt: A dog standing alert in front of a garden gate and barking with its mouth open. Friendly natural anatomy and small sound arcs, not snarling or threatening anyone.
scenes.basis: The gate example teaches the dog voice.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: めそめそ is excluded, but crying remains compatible with allowed しくしく unless broad open-mouth wailing, rather than quiet tears, is unmistakable.
scenes.description: A child cries with head tipped back, mouth wide open and tears on the cheeks while an adult offers comfort.
scenes.prompt: A child crying openly with mouth wide and tears on the cheeks while a caring adult kneels nearby offering comfort. Everyday upset only, with no injury, abandonment, frightening cause or written sound.
scenes.basis: The child bawling and the distinction between 鳴く and 泣く explicitly teach human crying.

advisoryReview.note: The broad open-mouth wailing pose is unmistakably different from quiet subdued tears. Promote.

scenes.eligibilityReason: Secondary held for review: a sounding bell also cues allowed じりじり or ぴりぴり. Broad resonance marks have not yet established a distinct non-animal-noise association.
scenes.description: A large suspended bell fills an open hall with broad repeated vibration arcs.
scenes.prompt: A plain large bell being sounded in an otherwise empty open hall, broad repeated curved vibration marks spreading into the surrounding space. No inscriptions, ritual symbols, musical notes or human distress.
scenes.basis: Meaning explicitly includes loud resounding noise beyond barking or crying; the bell is an illustrative association.

advisoryReview.note: The resounding-noise association is useful in the article, but the allowed ringing-sound words remain plausible quiz answers. Retain article-only.

メーメー.coverageNotes: One conventional sheep-bleating voice. Preserve accepted sheep; attested spelling variants do not create another identity or a loanword sense.

scenes.prompt: A woolly sheep in a green pasture bleating with its mouth open and head lifted. Small simple sound arcs, a natural sheep face, no bell labels or writing.
